modules.name: Brumista
modules.description: Lets an AI agent read and patch your running Rack.

modules.name: Ghisa
modules.description: Feed Ghisa a melody, and it plays chords made from the notes the melody just played.

modules.name: Moleta
modules.description: A clock whose four outputs each skip beats by chance, and can lock what they skipped into a phrase.

modules.name: Moleta +
modules.description: Four more outputs for the Moleta on its left, each with its own ratio, chance and length.

modules.name: Gibigiana
modules.description: Echoes on the clock grid, each lane with its own chance of coming back.

modules.name: Gibigiana +
modules.description: One more echo lane for the Gibigiana on its left.

modules.name: Barbapedana
modules.description: A 16-step sequencer crossed with a random loop: each step is yours by a chance you set, and anchors capture the loop's notes.
